subject: FinSecure: DR playbook, RTO/RPO snapshots and test artifacts
messages:
From: Samuel Reed <samuel.reed@finsecure.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + DR playbook for pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. For the upcoming pilot and our internal risk review, the audit team needs the following evidence by COB next Tuesday:

- The current DR/playbook document describing failover steps and escalation paths
- RTO and RPO snapshots for the last three controlled tests and any service-impacting events in the past 12 months
- Test artifacts (logs, timestamps, outcome notes) from the most recent failover run

Can you point me to a secure link, or send the artifacts as attachments? If anything is sensitive, we can accept a share through your secure bucket or a pre-signed link.

Samuel
Samuel Reed

samuel.reed@finsecure.com

Samuel —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide the playbook and the last three test snapshots. High-level plan:

- I will attach the consolidated DR playbook (latest internal revision).
- Dev will export the RTO/RPO snapshot CSV and the raw test artifacts.
- Sergio will prepare a pre-signed S3 link for the larger runbook snapshots ZIP.

One ask: the failover test logs contain internal IPs that we prefer to keep within a controlled bucket. I will include the redacted HTML report here and share the signed link for the ZIP. If FinSecure needs full verbatim logs for legal reasons, let me know and we can route through our legal/infosec team.

Targeting a single package to you by EOD Monday (30 Mar). If that timing doesn't work, tell me the latest acceptable time.

Thanks,

— Stephanie

Team — short update on artifacts we will bundle:

1) rto_rpo_snapshot_20260324.csv — generated from our monitoring pipeline; columns: test_id, start_ts, failover_complete_ts, rto_seconds, rpo_minutes, notes
2) runbook-snapshots-20260325.zip — contains runbook screenshots, play-by-play timestamps, and config diffs for the test environment
3) failover_test_results-20260320.html — redacted HTML report (already attached in Stephanie's email)

Sergio: please produce a pre-signed link with 30-day expiry and post it here so Stephanie can send to Samuel. Also confirming the RTO numbers: mean observed RTO across last three controlled tests = 2m 18s (we include the CSV). RPO observed = 0 (no data loss) for the controlled runs; one incident in 2025-09 had RPO measured at ~4m due to delayed replication (that is flagged in the CSV).

I will stamp the CSV with checksums and include run IDs.

Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the playbook and the CSV snapshot; the pre-signed link worked fine. A couple of follow-ups before we close the evidence item:

- Can you confirm the maintenance window policy that governs running controlled failover tests (we need to cite the window and approval flow)?
- We'd like to schedule one short, observed failover run during the pilot window so our auditors can witness the process. Can you propose two dates next week (UTC windows preferred)?

If you can send answers to those two points and any brief notes on the redaction approach for the HTML report, we should be able to mark this as completed.

Samuel
On Mon, 30 Mar 2026 at 13:45 Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samuel —
>
> Great — we can provide both. Maintenance window policy: maintenance is performed weekdays 02:00-06:00 UTC; controlled failovers require approval from SRE on-call and Security (we'll attach the approval flow excerpt to the package).
>
> Proposed observation slots (UTC): Wed 2026-04-07 03:00-04:00 or Thu 2026-04-08 03:00-04:00. Please confirm preferred slot and we'll schedule runbook owners and the on-call SRE.
>
> Redaction approach: we replace internal IPs and account IDs with stable placeholders and include a map in a secure appendix for auditors under NDA.
>
> — Stephanie
